text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as autumn drew near—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I couldn't help but feel concerned 
about Stay Gold's behavior from the other 
day."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Too soon—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Stay Gold seemed to carry an 
unprecedented sense of tension back then."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you could say it wasn't 
like her—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Boy, your brow is furrowed pretty deep 
there.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was extremely rare for her to show up 
on her own initiative. Wondering if 
something had happened, I asked her—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Could you check which race Suzuka is 
running in next?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...There's something on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Upon looking into it, I quickly found 
that Silence Suzuka had recently expressed 
a strong desire to run in the Mainichi 
Okan.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The Mainichi Okan, huh...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Haha, you're quick to understand.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll gladly take you up on that 
offer. Let me run in the Mainichi Okan."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"I've got a feeling this might just help 
me see what's what."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Beats me. I'd like to know that myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Mainichi Okan—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. I wonder how well I can do 
at 1,800m."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's just part of the charm of 
traveling—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(A presence piercing through my entire 
body... This is————)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Can't hear a thing, huh? ...Totally 
locked in the zone."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Suzuka. Where are you right now?
